title: Serper (web search)
description: Google results through Serper as gohort's web search, declared as a service: the request and how its results are read are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Get an API key at serper.dev (new accounts come with free searches). The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as Service: <name>. No price is declared, as it depends on your plan: add a per_call cost to the connector's spec to see what searches cost.
